content.text: Still scrolling through the long table of companies and tracks. I'll skim the last screens and then pick one.

I'm going with **Meitav, the "עוקב מדדי מניות" track**. I'm fairly sure about it. What decided it: it had the biggest returns I saw from a name I actually know, **25.86%** over 3 years and **17.25%** over 5. Its fee is 0.65%, about the same as everyone else. My friends always say "the S&P", and the S&P tracks here only show around 13–14%. So this one looks about twice as good for the same money.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** the heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" button was already picked, so I was in the right place. There are 143 tracks from 12 companies, which is a lot.
- **Harel:** the first big number I saw was Harel "מניות" at 24.04%, and it stuck with me. Harel "עוקב מדד S&P 500" had 13.7%. That looked like the safe pick for about a minute.
- **The rest of the table:** I scrolled through Mor, Analyst, Meitav, Altshuler Shaham, Phoenix, Yalin Lapidot, Migdal, Clal, Menora and Infinity. I only looked at the track names and the big return numbers.
- **Where it clicked:** Meitav "עוקב מדדי מניות", 25.86% and 17.25%. Analyst "עוקב מדדים - גמיש" was a bit higher (26.39%), but I don't know what "גמיש" means and Analyst sounds less familiar. Meitav I've heard of.
- **Skipped:** the filter buttons, the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link, the search box, the ⓘ icons, the small grey line at the bottom, and the footer. I jumped from about screen 13 straight to the last screen, so I didn't see screens 14–15.

**Where I got stuck:**
- Lots of rows say "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a return. I just ignored those.
- Orange "עוד לא דווח" marks with a warning icon (on some Migdal, Clal and Menora rows, among others) put me off those rows.
- I didn't understand the מניות / מט"ח percentages and the little rings. I guessed it's how much is in shares and how much is in dollars.
- The fee has two parts, "מהחיסכון" and "מההפקדות". I don't know what the difference is, and I think "מההפקדות" is usually 0%.
- They're all around 0.5–0.7%. I can't tell if that's a lot. With no shekel amount, it sounds like nothing.
- The page never says what to do first, like where to click to actually open the fund.
